run_check_inference_inputs: run the utility script to check consistency between InferenceClient method parameters and generated types
check_method_signature: check that a method's parameters match the corresponding generated input type dataclass
verify_parameter_documentation: verify that all method parameters are documented in their docstrings
inspect_inference_client_methods: inspect InferenceClient methods to validate parameter alignment with generated types
test_check_method_function: test the check_method function with a method name and method object to detect inconsistencies
